freak.definition: n. a person or animal that is markedly unusual or deformed
freak.translation:
n. 畸形人, 畸形物, 不正常的事物, 反复无常
a. 奇异的, 反常的

freak show.translation: 畸形秀; 畸形人展览

freak stocks.translation: [化] 非商品性的石油产品; 石油中间产品

freak-out.translation: n. 吸毒引起的幻觉, 通过吸毒逃避现实的人, 逃避现实, 反常的行动

freak-outs.translation: (freak-out 的复数) n. 吸毒引起的幻觉, 通过吸毒逃避现实的人, 逃避现实, 反常的行动

freaked.translation: a. 有奇特的斑纹的, 有奇特的条纹的

freaked-out.translation: 吓坏了的；受惊扰的（freak out的过去式）

freakier.definition:
s. strange and somewhat frightening
s. conspicuously or grossly unconventional or unusual
freakier.translation: a. 畸形的, 捉摸不定的( freaky的比较级 )

freakiest.definition:
s. strange and somewhat frightening
s. conspicuously or grossly unconventional or unusual
freakiest.translation: a. 畸形的, 捉摸不定的( freaky的最高级 )

freakiness.translation: 逃避现实; 行为反常; 古怪

freaking.definition:
p. pr. & vb. n. of Freak
a. Freakish.
freaking.translation:
a. （用以加强语气）该死的, 使人憎厌的, 糟透的
adv. 非常, 十分, 极
v. （使）强烈反应, 震惊, 畏惧( freak的现在分词 )

freakish.translation: a. 朝三暮四的, 见异思迁的, 畸形的

freakishly.translation: adv. 反常地；见异思迁地

freakishness.definition: n. marked strangeness as a consequence of being abnormal

freakout.translation: n. 迷幻状态, 嬉皮士聚会, 逃避现实, 逃避现实者

freaks.definition:
n a person or animal that is markedly unusual or deformed
n someone who is so ardently devoted to something that it resembles an addiction
v lose one's nerve
freaks.translation: n. 畸形人；怪胎（电影名）

freakshow.translation: n. 狂热的演出（歌曲名）; 怪物秀（电影名）

freaky.translation: a. (=freakish)畸形的, 捉摸不定的
